frozen_note: prompts copied verbatim from the first user message of each Muse Glimmer session (2026-10-20, /opt/data/tmp/museagent/home/state.db, sessions 20261020_1309..1314); only the work path /opt/data/tmp/museagent/work was replaced with /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work. muse_prompt_sha256 is the hash of the ORIGINAL prompt text.
smoke_prompt: Use the terminal tool to run: echo smoke-ok > /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/smoke/s.txt. Then say done.

tasks.label: create a file
tasks.prompt:
Create the file /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t01/hello.txt containing exactly the single line: muse glimmer was here
Then read it back to confirm and tell me it is done.

tasks.label: CSV column total
tasks.prompt: The file /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t02/sales.csv has a header row and a column called amount. Compute the total of the amount column and write just that number (no other text) to /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t02/total.txt.

tasks.label: find a phrase in 5 files
tasks.prompt: Exactly one of the five .txt files in /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t03/docs contains the phrase "blue heron protocol". Find it and write only its file name (for example note_x.txt, not the full path) to /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t03/answer.txt.

tasks.label: fix a bug until tests pass
tasks.prompt: In /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t04 there is a small Python module stats.py and a test script test.py. Running python3 test.py in that folder currently fails. Fix the bug in stats.py (do not edit test.py) so that python3 test.py passes, and run it to confirm.

tasks.label: folder + 3 files + index
tasks.prompt: Inside /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t05 create a folder called project. In it write three files: a.txt containing alpha, b.txt containing beta, c.txt containing gamma. Then write /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t05/project/index.txt listing the three file names a.txt, b.txt, c.txt, one per line, sorted alphabetically.

tasks.label: fetch a web page, write a fact
tasks.prompt: Fetch the web page https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/ (use a web tool, or curl from the terminal if no web tool works) and write the name of the product that page documents, as a single line, to /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t06/fact.txt.

tasks.label: count ERROR lines in a log
tasks.prompt: Count how many lines in /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t07/app.log contain the exact uppercase word ERROR. Write only the number to /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t07/count.txt.

tasks.label: edit two JSON keys
tasks.prompt: In /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t08/config.json, change the value of server.port to 8443 and set logging.level to "debug". Keep every other key and value unchanged and keep the file valid JSON.

tasks.label: recover from a failing script
tasks.prompt: Run the script /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t09/run_report.sh with bash. If it fails, work out why, fix the environment (do not edit the script itself) and run it again until it succeeds. It should produce /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t09/out/report.txt.

tasks.label: 40 lines to 3 bullets
tasks.prompt: Read /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t10/notes.txt (40 lines of meeting notes). Write a summary to /opt/data/tmp/sparkagent/work/t10/summary.txt that is exactly 3 lines, each line a bullet starting with "- ", no blank lines and nothing else in the file. The summary must mention the launch date, the budget figure and the owner of the migration.
